items.name: OpenCode
items.reason: Current maintained upstream is pinned and allowed only through a governed wrapper route. The common Safe Engineering Profile is live in PREPROD, but OpenCode itself is not installed or executed; keep it as a bounded wrapper candidate only when it provides measured unique value.

items.name: Superpowers
items.reason: Planning, TDD, systematic debugging, worktree isolation, review and branch-finish discipline are already materialized in the common Safe Engineering Profile. No separate runtime or agent is justified.

items.name: Addy Osmani Agent Skills
items.reason: The define/plan/build/verify/review/ship lifecycle is already absorbed into the common Safe Engineering phases and deduplicated against existing engineering controls.

items.name: Karpathy Skills
items.reason: Behavioral guardrails are retained as attributed third-party patterns inside the common profile; no claim is made that the source is an official Karpathy-authored skill package and no external code executes.

items.name: Ponytail
items.reason: Its YAGNI/reuse/minimum-code value is already represented by REUSE_BEFORE_BUILD and IMPLEMENT_MINIMAL_CHANGE gates in the common profile.

items.name: Agency Agents
items.reason: Useful as a role-spec source only. Creating hundreds of parallel agents or servers would duplicate CEREBRO's shared runtime and violates the factory/runtime architecture.

items.name: e2e patterns
items.reason: CEREBRO already has QA/E2E and verification gates; the correct action is extending QA-001 rather than adding another engine or dependency.

items.name: Git worktrees/sandboxes
items.reason: Native Git isolation plus existing branch/PR gates are already the default mutation boundary. No new engine or external dependency is required.

items.name: OpenClaw
items.reason: Gateway/harness patterns are useful benchmarks, but CEREBRO already has Gateway/Router/runtime. Replacing them or importing a second core runtime is not justified.

items.name: Hermes Agent
items.reason: Persistent memory/tools/skills/cron/MCP are benchmark value only because equivalent governed surfaces already exist or are being extended inside CEREBRO.

items.name: AbacusAI Bot OSS
items.reason: It is a useful application benchmark, not a stable core runtime contract for CEREBRO. No dependency is required.

items.name: Claude-Mem
items.reason: Memory-engine patterns may be useful in LAB, but CEREBRO source-of-truth and memory governance remain canonical. Hosted/private open-core areas are not assumed available or free.

items.name: Evolver
items.reason: Only patterns/benchmark value is retained. Code reuse stays blocked unless a future explicit license/legal gate clears it; no paid or external runtime is required.
